title: Do Your Buses Get Stuck in Traffic? (The Downs-Thomson Paradox)
summary: Not Just Bikes explains the Downs-Thomson paradox using Amsterdam and Toronto: road widening doesn't fix congestion, and buses stuck in traffic make transit slow. It argues for giving transit its own priority infrastructure.
why: HN points to it as a clear introduction to why widening roads fails and why transit-only lanes matter.

quote.text: NotJustBikes has a good introduction to it
